title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Is it permissible to choose "Hadi" as a Muslim baby name 12620 views Q. I am going to have a baby in December if Allah wishes. If it is a boy I am thinking of keeping his name ‘Umar Bin Sajjad’ and if it is a girl then I will be keeping it as ‘Aisha Bint Sajjad’. What is your saying? 1908 views Q. Alhamdulillah, I am blessed with a baby boy last week and thought to keep his name as Shahzain, so kindly request you to give us your valuable advice and suggestions for this name or else if possible suggest us good baby boy names. 7407 views Q. Can we name a Muslim as Abdul Kashif? 4140 views Q. 1. We have named a child Subhan Ahmed Keen, knowing Subhan is name of Allah Subhan wa tallah but since it does not come in the 99 names of Allah we thought it was ok to use it. Now we have read in Maaruf ul Quraan where Mufti Shafi says that except 4-5 names of Allah other names (he mentions Subhan cannot be used; on page 134 Vol4, Aayat 180 of Surat Al Aaraaf) cannot be used. Please guide us. 5060 views Q. Baby girl name 12542 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum, Dear Brother, My name is Naseer and I am working in Dubai. I am sending this question on behalf of my friend. My friend name is Shakeel Ahmed. He has blessed with 3 son as of now. The names of his first two sons are 1). Faizan Muhammed & 2). Muhammed Farhaan. His third son name is Muhammed Subhan and his age is 2 years. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. Because it is not good to naming for a muslim child as Muhammed Subhan. We would like to know the answer for this uestion from your end. PLease try to give the reply as soon as possible. Thanks in advance. 1684 views Q. My son's name is Baasil, which as per my knowledge means brave, royal. Kindly confirm the meaning and also advice whether it is necessary to add Mohammed or Ahmed to his name? 1935 views Q. Need Name of boy match with Afraz 3702 views Q. What are the meanings of Muhammad Ridwanul Alam and Namir, Jarir, Affan, Fawzaan 1970 views Q. Aqsa name for girl child 8197 views Q. clarification on name 3491 views Q. My Malasian friend put names his sons as Abuhuraira and Abusahidulqudri, please confirm is it good? 2066 views Q. Is it allowed to keep the name Utbah? 2228 views Q. Islamic names 4076 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 46573 Country: India Title: Name Meaning Question: Myself Shahzad Alam and I want to know its meanings. Is it correct or incorrect suggest to me a beautiful name. Answer ID: 46573 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1019/797/H=1434) Shahzad Alam means “a big person of the world”. Though this name is correct but if you keep the name Abdullah or Abdur Rahman it is far better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
